support.instructions: Given only the supplied claim and short source summaries, classify whether the evidence is sufficiently supportive, materially contradictory, or still unclear.

criteria.supported: Multiple supplied source summaries directly support the claim without a material contradiction.
criteria.contradicted: A supplied authoritative source materially conflicts with the claim.
criteria.unclear: Evidence is incomplete, indirect, mixed, or insufficient.
